name: guild
description: Continuous agent orchestration on a Turso-backed board where status is a column, not a directory. A live 3-way interview between product-owner, architect, and user plans each requirement; goals and phases give it direction; tickets name a required CAPABILITY rather than an agent, so any roster member whose declared capabilities cover it is eligible and adding an agent file is the whole of hiring; the board then drives parallel development, test planning, unit & integration testing, and a 4-reviewer pass that produces a report for user-approved fixes. 'guild brief' narrates the board and 'guild dashboard' renders it as one offline HTML page, while an independent QA discipline files bugs and maps risk coverage as rows. A capability nothing in the roster covers is a loud roster gap the architect files at plan time, not a silent fallback. Recovery is a journal replay. Say 'check in' to start a work session.
